name: Narukaze Minamo
source:
She has practiced playing her harmonica for four years hoping for [url=/c471]Makoto[/url] to return and keep his promise. Unlike [url=/c471]Makoto[/url], she takes their childhood promise seriously and wants to marry now that they are older. Throughout the game she is straightforward and assertive about her love for [url=/c471]Makoto[/url].
[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wind:_A_Breath_of_Heart]Wikipedia[/url]]

[spoiler]Is the real sister of [url=/c472]Hinata[/url] and [url=/c13712]Wakaba[/url].[/spoiler]
